original_submission.content:
import os, shlex, subprocess
base = "storage/shared/entropy_collab"
specs = [
    os.path.join(base, "erudite_v40_specimen.json"),
    os.path.join(base, "erudite_v41_specimen.json"),
    os.path.join(base, "erudite_v42_specimen.json"),
]
v39 = os.path.join(base, "erudite_v39_specimen.json")
if os.path.exists(v39):
    specs.insert(0, v39)
cmd = "python storage/shared/entropy_collab/examples/run_multi_specimen_v1_8.py 1000 0 " + " ".join(specs)
rc = subprocess.call(shlex.split(cmd))
print("RUN_V18_WITH_V39_RC", rc)
